name: Obfuscation via Vector Dot Product
description: Replaces the explicit matrix equivalence (which models easily map to binary parity/opposite colors) with a vector dot product condition. The models must explicitly calculate the dot products of the assigned vectors to discover that a product of 20 requires assigning different modes, thereby recovering the 2-coloring constraint. Models relying on surface pattern matching of "opposite" or "swap" will fail to recognize the graph coloring structure.
